title: Scaffold Next.js + Drizzle schema + repo init
acceptance: WHEN `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 without modifying the lockfile.
WHEN `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 with `strict` true in `tsconfig.json`.
WHEN `pnpm exec drizzle-kit migrate` runs against `TEST_DATABASE_URL` on an empty database THE SYSTEM SHALL create the `personnel`, `ticket`, `verification_station`, and `ticket_download_log` tables.
WHEN a query is issued through the exported `db` client in `src/db/client.ts` THE SYSTEM SHALL return typed rows with no `any`.
WHEN `DATABASE_URL` is absent at import time THE SYSTEM SHALL throw a named error from `src/lib/env.ts` rather than failing at the first query.
WHEN `pnpm exec vitest run tests/db/client.test.ts` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL report 0 failed.
note: Verified against a real Postgres instance (VPS, boleteria_test database) on 2026-09-18 — full suite (pnpm exec vitest run) reports 34/34 passed, including the 10-concurrent-request race test in E2-T2. Two real bugs found and fixed by this verification pass: tests/setup.ts fell back to TEST_DATABASE_URL only when DATABASE_URL was unset (true locally, false on any deployed environment with its own real DATABASE_URL — now always overrides, unconditionally); vitest ran test files in parallel against the one shared test database, causing cross-file FK races (fileParallelism:false in vitest.config.ts fixes it).

title: Import CSV de personal con validación estricta
acceptance: WHEN a CSV row is missing a required field THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the whole import and report the row number and field name.
WHEN two rows share the same `cip` THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the import and report both row numbers.
WHEN two rows share the same `dni` THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the import and report both row numbers.
WHEN a CSV validates cleanly THE SYSTEM SHALL replace the `personnel` table contents inside one transaction — either every row lands or none does.
WHEN `pnpm exec tsx scripts/import-personnel.ts --file {path}` is invoked with a valid file THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 and print the row count imported.
WHEN `pnpm exec vitest run tests/lib/import-personnel.test.ts` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL report 0 failed.

title: Flujo de registro: búsqueda, validación CIP/DNI, ticket idempotente
acceptance: WHEN a valid `cip`+`dni` matching a `personnel` row is submitted with the consent checkbox checked THE SYSTEM SHALL create exactly one `ticket` row for that `personnel_id`.
WHEN the same `personnel_id` submits again THE SYSTEM SHALL return the existing ticket instead of creating a second row — the `ticket` count for that person stays 1.
WHEN `cip` matches a record but `dni` does not THE SYSTEM SHALL reject with `{ ok:false, error:{code:'INVALID_CREDENTIALS'} }` and create no ticket.
WHEN the consent checkbox is not checked THE SYSTEM SHALL reject with `{ ok:false, error:{code:'CONSENT_REQUIRED'} }`.
WHEN `pnpm exec vitest run tests/server/tickets.test.ts` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL report 0 failed.

title: Generación de QR con token HMAC firmado + pantalla de ticket
acceptance: WHEN a ticket is created THE SYSTEM SHALL store a `qr_token` that is a valid HMAC-SHA256 signed payload encoding the ticket id.
WHEN `verifyQrToken` is called with a tampered payload (one character altered) THE SYSTEM SHALL return `{ valid:false }`.
WHEN `verifyQrToken` is called with the exact stored token THE SYSTEM SHALL return `{ valid:true, ticketId }` matching the ticket.
WHEN `/ticket/[id]` is requested for an existing ticket THE SYSTEM SHALL render a PNG QR image generated server-side from the stored token.
WHEN `pnpm exec vitest run tests/lib/qr-token.test.ts` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL report 0 failed.

title: Buscar mi ticket (CIP+DNI) con rate limiting
acceptance: WHEN a `cip`+`dni` lookup matches an issued ticket THE SYSTEM SHALL return that ticket's id.

WHEN 5 failed lookups for the same `cip` occur within one hour THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the 6th attempt with `{ ok:false, error:{code:'RATE_LIMITED'} }` regardless of whether the credentials are correct.
WHEN a failed lookup is older than one hour THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT count toward the rate limit.
WHEN `pnpm exec vitest run tests/server/rate-limit.test.ts` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL report 0 failed.

title: Gestión de estaciones de verificación + sesión de estación
acceptance: WHEN an admin creates a station THE SYSTEM SHALL store only a hash of its code, never the plaintext, in `verification_station.code_hash`.
WHEN an admin rotates a station's code THE SYSTEM SHALL make the old code's hash no longer match on the next verification attempt.
WHEN a valid, active station code is submitted at `/verificar/login` THE SYSTEM SHALL set a signed station-session cookie and redirect to `/verificar`.
WHEN an invalid station code is submitted THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it and set no cookie.
WHEN a station is deactivated (`active=false`) THE SYSTEM SHALL reject that station's code even if it is otherwise correct.
WHEN `pnpm exec vitest run tests/server/stations.test.ts` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL report 0 failed.

title: Verificación por cámara con UPDATE atómico anti-doble-uso
acceptance: WHEN a valid, unverified ticket's QR token is submitted to `/api/verify` THE SYSTEM SHALL set `status='verified'`, record `verified_at` and `verified_by_station`, and return `{ ok:true, data:{ alreadyVerified:false } }`.
WHEN the same ticket is submitted a second time THE SYSTEM SHALL return `{ ok:true, data:{ alreadyVerified:true, verifiedAt, stationLabel } }` and SHALL NOT change the stored `verified_at`.
WHEN a token with an invalid HMAC signature is submitted THE SYSTEM SHALL reject with `{ ok:false, error:{code:'INVALID_SIGNATURE'} }` before any database write.

WHEN 10 concurrent verification requests are issued for the SAME ticket id THE SYSTEM SHALL mark it verified exactly once — exactly 1 of the 10 responses has `alreadyVerified:false` and 9 have `alreadyVerified:true`.
WHEN `pnpm exec vitest run tests/server/verify-concurrency.test.ts` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL report 0 failed.

title: Dashboard admin: contador en vivo + tabla filtrable + login UI
acceptance: WHEN `/api/admin/stats` is called by an authenticated admin THE SYSTEM SHALL return `{ ok:true, data:{ verified:number, total:number } }` matching the real `ticket` and `personnel` counts.
WHEN an unauthenticated request hits `/api/admin/stats` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 401 and return no counts.
WHEN a ticket's status changes to `verified` between two calls THE SYSTEM SHALL reflect the new count on the next call to `/api/admin/stats`.
WHEN `pnpm exec vitest run tests/server/stats.test.ts` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL report 0 failed.
note: Code complete, tsc/biome pass. All 3 tests hit the usual ECONNREFUSED (beforeEach seeds an admin user). Added better-auth/next-js's nextCookies() plugin to src/lib/auth.ts — without it, auth.api.signInEmail called from a server action never sets the browser's session cookie; verified the fix is real by extracting Set-Cookie from an asResponse:true sign-in and replaying it as a Cookie header in the test, which is also how the test authenticates against the route's GET handler directly (no HTTP server spun up). Added src/server/stats.ts (getAdminStats, getAttendanceRows), src/app/providers.tsx (TanStack Query provider, wired into root layout — first thing in the app to need it), and src/app/(admin)/login/{actions,admin-login-form}.tsx (not in original files list, same pattern as other login flows). AttendanceTable duplicates the AttendanceRow type locally instead of importing it from src/server/stats.ts, per CLAUDE.md's boundary rule (components must never import server/).

title: CI pipeline y verificación de build de producción
acceptance: WHEN `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs on a push THE SYSTEM SHALL execute install, typecheck, lint, unit tests and build, failing the job if any step exits non-zero.
WHEN `pnpm build` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 and produce a `.next` production build with zero type errors.
WHEN the built app is started with `pnpm start` and `GET /` is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL return HTTP 200.
WHEN `GET /api/health` is requested against the running build THE SYSTEM SHALL return HTTP 200 with `{ ok:true, data:{ db:'ok' } }` after checking a real database connection.
